points.text:
Occupant load: **business = 150 SF gross** in the 2021 IBC (it was 100 in 2018).

- round occupant load UP
- check both the capacity and the 44 in minimum

cards.question: Minimum number of exits for 620 occupants on one storey

questions.question: A sprinklered Group B floor has an occupant load of 180. Which governs the stair width?
options: The 36 in minimum for fewer than 50 occupants
questions.explanation: 180 × 0.2 = 36 in is below the 44 in minimum for 50 or more occupants, so the minimum governs. 0.3 in applies only without sprinklers plus voice/alarm.
